securityAudit: 2026-11-07 dual audit (Android + backend): no CRITICAL/HIGH findings; tracked trade-offs live in docs/SECURITY.md (S-1..S-9)

tasks.title: Verifiably installable and upgradeable database bootstrap and forward migration
tasks.tests: Migration syntax, table & function signatures, DDL replay order, auth checks
tasks.result: Canonical forward migrations hardened: legacy resolve_profile_by_share_id table signature dropped and replaced with authenticated-only JSONB resolver; obsolete create_attachment overloads dropped; conversations INSERT namespace secured; attachments uploader_id and size synchronized via compatibility trigger
tasks.limitation: Live remote Supabase deploy requires owner credentials

tasks.title: Account deletion: typed result propagated from server to UI without wiping shared vault
tasks.tests: DeleteAccountVaultPreservationTest (Robolectric, interceptor-faked server): failure preserves vault, confirmed deletion returns typed Success, unauthenticated deletion fails closed; gradle :app:testDebugUnitTest
tasks.result: Server-side account deletion with typed DeleteAccountResult propagated from service through repository to ViewModel, fail-closed handling, and account-scoped local data wipe without destroying shared prefs
tasks.limitation: Multi-user hardware keystore separation constrained by single Android Keystore

tasks.title: Crypto backup without replacing active identity
tasks.tests: Fingerprint preservation before/after backup attempt; hardware key non-destructive failure test; CryptoBackupSafetyTest
tasks.result: Eliminated destructive software keypair fallback; verified fail-closed HardwareKeyNonExportableException when exportable keys are absent; correspondence checks ensure public and private keys match prior to backup payload derivation
tasks.limitation: Hardware-backed Android Keystore keys cannot be exported off-chip

tasks.title: Telegram service: inbox, OTP state, idempotency and delivery outbox
tasks.tests: Validation of mandatory webhook secret, non-reset of attempts on repeated /start, idempotent verify
tasks.result: Closed security holes in webhook and verify functions: secret token validation compares SHA-256 digests in constant time (no length leak) and fails closed; attempts counter preserved across repeated /start commands; atomic row-locked verify_telegram_challenge_atomic and single-use recovery challenges
tasks.limitation: Live Telegram Bot API delivery depends on configured TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN secret

tasks.title: Common session and token gateway
tasks.tests: Session token refresh propagation to Realtime; unit tests passing
tasks.result: Centralized token refresh mutex and state machine; updateAccessToken sends access_token event over active WebSocket, transparently reconnects, or queues the token during transitional states and flushes it after channel join (no silent drops); SyncManager propagates session changes seamlessly

tasks.title: Durable send and synchronization unified model
tasks.tests: Catch-up pagination and ACK persistence; gradle :app:testDebugUnitTest; SyncCursorTest
tasks.result: Paginated global sequence catch-up with per-page cursor checkpointing, bounded loop protection on both the global stream and the per-conversation catch-up (100-page cap plus a full-page cursor-stall guard against malformed sequence rows), and durable outbox deduplication

tasks.title: Edit and delete through durable queue and tombstone processing
tasks.tests: Soft delete empty payload handling and edit recipient targeting
tasks.result: Tombstones processed first before payload check in SyncManager; editMessage accurately encrypts for peer or self/AI recipients and verifies RPC response; local cache rolled back on server edit failure

tasks.title: Media pipeline, metadata and cleanup
tasks.tests: MIME separation from MessageType, cache isolation; AttachmentMimeTypeTest verifies exact type/subtype matching, parameter stripping and look-alike rejection
tasks.result: Exact type/subtype MIME validation (parameters stripped, prefix look-alikes rejected), streaming AES-GCM cipher pipeline to prevent OOM, uploader_id and owner_id alignment, and account-scoped cache clearing on account deletion

tasks.title: Cryptographic trust, multi-device and quarantine
tasks.tests: Signature verification and outbound self-decryption separation
tasks.result: Inbound peer message digital signatures strictly verified against canonical protocol envelopes; invalid signatures quarantined with Security Alert warning rather than presenting forged text; HMAC integrity checks precede GCM decryption

tasks.title: +999 virtual numbers, profile and QR integrity
tasks.tests: Virtual number normalization and authoritative state check; VirtualNumberIdentityTest
tasks.result: 8-digit +999 number validation, account-scoped persistence without empty-string wiping, and authoritative server sync

tasks.title: AI generation, transcript and quota consistency
tasks.tests: AI conversation isolation and prompt outbox deduplication; AiPipelineTest
tasks.result: Strict persona validation: unknown or missing persona_id is rejected with HTTP 400 UNKNOWN_PERSONA (no silent fallback to hexagon), system prompts, conversation type isolation, and resilient quota error localization

tasks.title: Product state and lifecycle
tasks.tests: Lifecycle and state preservation across configuration changes
tasks.result: rememberSaveable integration for active message drafting preventing input loss on screen rotation or lifecycle events
